annotation.evidence_span: treat receipt of any frame other than PRIORITY as a connection error
annotation.interpretation_a: It is unclear whether the clause applies only to frames received after the stream is closed or to all frames.
annotation.justification: The clause lacks a clear constraint on when frames other than PRIORITY should trigger a PROTOCOL_ERROR, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify the context in which the error applies, leaving the scope of "any frame" ambiguous.
